units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:8">Ab. V, 8</cite> <he>רעב של כ׳</he> a destructive famine (general miscrop).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:11">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot.
Snh. 63ᵃ נתחייבו שונאיהם … כ׳ the enemies of Israel (censorial change רשעיהם, euphem. for Israel) would have been condemned to destruction.
Gen. R. s. 10 אין ויכלו … לשון כ׳ vaykhullu (Gen. II, 1) has the meaning of affliction, of diminution (ref. to the reduction of the planetary courses after Adam’s sin).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> (expl. <he>כלה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 18:21">Gen. XVIII, 21</cite>) <he>כ׳ הן חייבין</he> they deserve extinction; [Targ. Y. II, Gen. l. c. <he>כַּלַּיָּיה עבדו גמירא</he>, read: <he>עבדו כְּלָיָיה גמירא</he>]. Mekh. B’shall., Shirah, s. 5 <he>גמרת … כ׳</he> thou hast passed the verdict of destruction &c.; a. fr.
